dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, we've been fighting for a while now. Are you holding up okay?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: I've prepared some treats and drinks to perk us up. They're nutritious too, so you'll recover your energy in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Being well-supplied is essential to victory. So let your Patissiere Supreme take care of all your nutritional needs!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: I've heard that when snow-winged geese are migrating in winter, they adopt a formation where the current generated by the lead goose helps the flock cover the long distances.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: If the lead goose ever gets tired, it falls to the back to save energy... The flock only makes it as far as it does by working as a team and taking care of each other.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: All of which is to say, don't charge out ahead alone! Remember there's a whole team behind you, and we've got your back.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: You know, it occurs to me that I'd probably get along with the manager of this mysterious place really well.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: When I first got here, I heard that elegant and dignified symphony. It's my favorite kind of music.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: If we ever got to meet, I'd present them with the perfect dish to accompany that symphony, as a thank-you gift for the great mood this music's put me in.
